snippet.title: RTFM Project Trailer | A side quest from Dinosaur Polo Club
snippet.description:
Welcome to all Troubleshooters and Operators. We at Harmonic are thrilled to celebrate the reopening of the echo and epsilon-level Troubleshooter Wings after their refurbishment. All cubicles have been decontaminated and cleared for [REDACTED]. Orientation begins 1st April, 2026. 

RTFM is an experimental game jam project by Dinosaur Polo Club, released under an alternative label "DPC Labs." We look forward to sharing more of their experiments with you in the future.

For more information visit: https://rtfm.nz/ or https://dinopoloclub.itch.io/
